release.title: Airborne laser scanning single tree detection NEWFOR benchmark dataset

sources: Fields of each area are transcribed from its plot sheet (XX_Metadata.pdf of the release). forest, forest_class, conifer_percent and stems_per_ha are from Tables 1 and 2 of the benchmark paper. The Montafon flight date is from Table 1 of the paper: its plot sheet lists two flights, 2004 and 2011, without saying which is released.

areas.name: Saint-Agnan
areas.notes: 32 degree slope facing west; a road splits the plot; most broadleaved trees lean downslope.

areas.name: Cotolivier plot 02
areas.notes: 31 degree slope facing north-east. The paper gives 2012/9 as the Cotolivier inventory date; the plot sheet gives 8 and 20 November 2012.

areas.name: Cotolivier plot 10
areas.notes: 27 degree slope facing north. The paper gives 2012/9 as the Cotolivier inventory date; the plot sheet gives 13 June 2013.

areas.name: Cotolivier plot 09
areas.notes: Grazed larch wood, sparse cover, 14 degree slope.

areas.name: Holzschopf
areas.notes: Subalpine spruce near the tree line. The cloud carries no classification (every point is class 0) and the terrain raster no CRS. The inventory holds 20 stems below the stated 10 cm caliper threshold.

areas.name: Pellizzano area 5
areas.epsg_source: plot sheet (UTM WGS84 frame 32N, no code given)
areas.notes: The terrain raster is tagged EPSG:32633; the coordinates fit zone 32N at the plot's longitude, as the plot sheet says. Point times are all zero.

areas.name: Pellizzano area 1
areas.epsg_source: plot sheet (UTM WGS84 frame 32N, no code given)
areas.notes: Spruce pole forest. The terrain raster is tagged EPSG:32633; the coordinates fit zone 32N. Point times are all zero. The inventory holds 6 stems below the stated 5 cm caliper threshold.

areas.name: Asiago area 22
areas.epsg_source: plot sheet (UTM WGS84 frame 32N, no code given)
areas.notes: One inventory row has a diameter of zero (height 16.3 m). Point times are all zero.

areas.name: Asiago area 26
areas.epsg_source: plot sheet (UTM WGS84 frame 32N, no code given)
areas.notes: Two inventory rows have a diameter of 0.4 cm (heights 4.1 and 4.4 m), below the caliper threshold. Point times are all zero.

areas.name: Asiago area 38
areas.epsg_source: plot sheet (UTM WGS84 frame 32N, no code given)
areas.notes: Beech coppice in both layers. Point times are all zero.

areas.name: Leskova dolina plot 15
areas.notes: Class 2 of the cloud is not ground (its points lie up to tens of metres above the released terrain). The terrain raster carries no CRS.

areas.name: Leskova dolina plot 16
areas.notes: Class 2 of the cloud is not ground. The terrain raster carries no CRS.

areas.name: Leskova dolina plot 17
areas.notes: Class 2 of the cloud is not ground. The terrain raster carries no CRS.

areas.name: Leskova dolina plot 18
areas.notes: Class 2 of the cloud is not ground. The cloud is not centred on the plot: it reaches 16 to 33 m beyond the scoring polygon. The terrain raster carries no CRS.
